proof_dependency_chain: Finite-free dual tensor-Hom isomorphism respects tower transitions.
Tensor commutes with the explicit filtered colimit.
Countability and torsion-freeness of M survive without injective transitions.
Representability implies the canonical countable-product comparison.
An enumeration in M^N plus one finite tensor expression forces finite generation.
Finite generation and torsion-freeness give finite freeness.
Duality produces the representing group and all-small-limit preservation.
Naturality from Z determines every component of every transformation.
